newsitem.title: FRANCE: Air France Sept cargo growth up 12.9 pct.
newsitem.headline: Air France Sept cargo growth up 12.9 pct.

text.p: Air France said its September global cargo traffic at 434.9 million freight-tonne-kilometres (FTK) was 12.9 percent above September 1995.
The overall cargo load factor in September 1996 was 3.7 percentage points above the same month last year at 72.4 percent, the French state airline added.
In the first six months of its current financial year (April 1996-March 1997), Air France transported 2.39 billion FTK, up 6.9 percent on April-September 1995, the airline said.
Overall cargo load factor during April-September 1996 was 0.3 percentage points above the previous year's levels at 67.3 percent, Air France added.
